title: 15 Best Performing ETFs of 2019
关键词: US Global GO GOLD and Precious Metal Miners ETF (GOAU)
Global X MSCI Consumer Staples ETF (CHIS)
US Global GO GOLD and Precious Metal Miners ETF
Global X MSCI Consumer Staples ETF
主要内容: In 2019, SPDR S&P Semiconductor ETF (XSD) rose 64.62%, aiming to mirror the total return performance of the semiconductor segment of the S&P Total Market Index. VanEck Vectors Semiconductor ETF (SMH) gained 64.23% year-to-date, replicating the price and yield performance of the MVIS US Listed Semiconductor 25 Index. ETFMG Prime Junior Silver ETF (SILJ) and US Global GO GOLD and Precious Metal Miners ETF (GOAU) reported gains of 56.87% and 53.72%, respectively, focusing on precious metals production. The Global X MSCI Consumer Staples ETF (CHIS) achieved a 50.88% year-to-date return, tracking the MSCI China Consumer Staples 10/50 Index. The article contrasts traditional clean energy ETFs with the diversified approach of ACES, covering seven clean energy themes such as solar, wind, and electric vehicles.
